text: A careful engineer compares two implementations and records the tradeoffs before choosing one.
The traveler checked the weather, packed a raincoat, and left early for the station.
A biologist labels the samples, checks the control group, and writes an observation.
When the first calculation failed, the student inspected each assumption and tried again.
The recipe calls for flour, water, salt, and enough time for the dough to rise.
A reviewer reads the function, finds the boundary condition, and proposes a focused test.
The museum guide describes the painting without guessing what the artist privately intended.
Before answering, verify which facts are observed and which claims remain uncertain.
